description:
Update a time entry you own (managers can update anyone's). Pass only what changes: service, date (YYYY-MM-DD), hours (exact decimal, 0.1 = 6 minutes), note, or task. Pass task or note as an empty string to clear it. Entries of a delivered budget are locked. An entry of another organization returns not_found. Only @seoalive.com accounts can use the time tracking tools.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// change an entry to 2 hours.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","entry":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","hours":"2"}
```
name: update_time_entry

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.
